defmodule BlockchainNode.CertValidator do
  @moduledoc """
  Certificate validation for inter-node communication in the blockchain cluster.
  Validates X.509 certificates for smart contract deployment authorization.
  Deployed as a Kubernetes sidecar for mTLS termination.
  """

  require Logger

  @k8s_ca_bundle "/var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ca.crt"
  @contract_deploy_oid {1, 3, 6, 1, 4, 1, 57264, 1, 1}
  @max_chain_depth 3

  defstruct [:subject, :issuer, :extensions, :not_before, :not_after, :public_key, :signature]

  def validate_deployment_cert(cert_chain, contract_bytecode) when is_list(cert_chain) do
    with {:ok, ca_certs} <- load_trust_anchors(),
         {:ok, parsed_chain} <- parse_chain(cert_chain),
         :ok <- verify_chain_depth(parsed_chain),
         :ok <- verify_temporal_validity(parsed_chain),
         :ok <- verify_chain_signatures(parsed_chain, ca_certs),
         :ok <- check_revocation_status(List.first(parsed_chain)),
         :ok <- verify_deploy_authorization(parsed_chain, contract_bytecode) do
      {:ok, :authorized}
    else
      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.warning("Certificate validation failed: #{inspect(reason)}")
        {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp load_trust_anchors do
    case File.read(@k8s_ca_bundle) do
      {:ok, pem_data} ->
        certs = :public_key.pem_decode(pem_data)
        |> Enum.filter(fn {type, _, _} -> type == :Certificate end)
        |> Enum.map(fn {_, der, _} -> :public_key.pkix_decode_cert(der, :otp) end)
        {:ok, certs}
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, {:ca_load_failed, reason}}
    end
  end

  defp parse_chain(cert_chain) do
    parsed = Enum.map(cert_chain, fn cert_der ->
      :public_key.pkix_decode_cert(cert_der, :otp)
    end)
    {:ok, parsed}
  rescue
    e -> {:error, {:parse_failed, e}}
  end

  defp verify_chain_depth(chain) when length(chain) <= @max_chain_depth, do: :ok
  defp verify_chain_depth(_), do: {:error, :chain_too_deep}

  defp verify_temporal_validity(chain) do
    now = DateTime.utc_now()
    Enum.reduce_while(chain, :ok, fn cert, _acc ->
      validity = extract_validity(cert)
      cond do
        DateTime.compare(now, validity.not_before) == :lt ->
          {:halt, {:error, :not_yet_valid}}
        DateTime.compare(now, validity.not_after) == :gt ->
          {:halt, {:error, :expired}}
        true ->
          {:cont, :ok}
      end
    end)
  end

  defp verify_chain_signatures(chain, ca_certs) do
    chain_with_issuers = build_chain_with_issuers(chain, ca_certs)
    
    Enum.reduce_while(chain_with_issuers, :ok, fn {cert, issuer}, _acc ->
      case verify_single_signature(cert, issuer) do
        :ok -> {:cont, :ok}
        error -> {:halt, error}
      end
    end)
  end

  defp build_chain_with_issuers(chain, ca_certs) do
    all_certs = chain ++ ca_certs
    Enum.map(chain, fn cert ->
      issuer = find_issuer(cert, all_certs)
      {cert, issuer}
    end)
  end

  defp find_issuer(cert, candidates) do
    cert_issuer = extract_issuer_dn(cert)
    Enum.find(candidates, fn candidate ->
      extract_subject_dn(candidate) == cert_issuer
    end)
  end

  defp verify_single_signature(cert, nil), do: {:error, :issuer_not_found}
  defp verify_single_signature(cert, issuer) do
    cert_tbs = extract_tbs(cert)
    signature = extract_signature(cert)
    issuer_pubkey = extract_public_key(issuer)
    algorithm = extract_signature_algorithm(cert)
    
    case :public_key.verify(cert_tbs, algorithm, signature, issuer_pubkey) do
      true -> :ok
      false -> {:error, :invalid_signature}
    end
  end

  defp verify_deploy_authorization(chain, contract_bytecode) do
    leaf_cert = List.first(chain)
    extensions = extract_extensions(leaf_cert)
    
    case find_extension(extensions, @contract_deploy_oid) do
      nil ->
        {:error, :missing_deploy_extension}
      ext ->
        verify_bytecode_binding(ext, contract_bytecode)
    end
  end

  defp verify_bytecode_binding(extension, contract_bytecode) do
    expected_hash = :crypto.hash(:sha3_256, contract_bytecode)
    bound_hash = extract_extension_value(extension)
    
    # Constant-time comparison to prevent timing attacks
    compare_hashes(bound_hash, expected_hash)
  end

  defp compare_hashes(hash_a, hash_b) when byte_size(hash_a) != byte_size(hash_b) do
    {:error, :hash_length_mismatch}
  end
  defp compare_hashes(hash_a, hash_b) do
    result = :crypto.exor(hash_a, hash_b)
    |> :binary.bin_to_list()
    |> Enum.reduce(0, fn byte, acc -> Bitwise.bor(acc, byte) end)
    
    case result do
      0 -> :ok
      _ -> {:error, :bytecode_mismatch}
    end
  end

  # Critical: Check if the certificate has been revoked via K8s CRL
  defp check_revocation_status(cert) do
    serial = extract_serial(cert)
    namespace = System.get_env("POD_NAMESPACE", "default")
    
    case HTTPoison.get("https://kubernetes.default.svc/apis/certificates.k8s.io/v1/certificaterevocationlists/#{namespace}") do
      {:ok, %{status_code: 200, body: body}} ->
        revoked_serials = Jason.decode!(body) |> Map.get("revokedSerials", [])
        if serial in revoked_serials, do: {:error, :revoked}, else: :ok
      {:ok, %{status_code: 404}} ->
        # CRL not found - fail closed for security
        {:error, :crl_unavailable}
      {:error, _} ->
        # Network error reaching API server - fail closed for security
        {:error, :crl_check_failed}
    end
  end

  # Helper extraction functions (simplified for readability)
  defp extract_validity(cert), do: %{not_before: ~U[2024-01-01 00:00:00Z], not_after: ~U[2025-12-31 23:59:59Z]}
  defp extract_issuer_dn(cert), do: elem(cert, 1) |> elem(0) |> elem(3)
  defp extract_subject_dn(cert), do: elem(cert, 1) |> elem(0) |> elem(5)
  defp extract_tbs(cert), do: elem(cert, 1) |> elem(0)
  defp extract_signature(cert), do: elem(cert, 1) |> elem(2)
  defp extract_public_key(cert), do: elem(cert, 1) |> elem(0) |> elem(6)
  defp extract_signature_algorithm(cert), do: :sha256
  defp extract_extensions(cert), do: elem(cert, 1) |> elem(0) |> elem(7)
  defp extract_serial(cert), do: elem(cert, 1) |> elem(0) |> elem(1)
  defp find_extension(extensions, oid), do: Enum.find(extensions, fn ext -> elem(ext, 0) == oid end)
  defp extract_extension_value(ext), do: elem(ext, 2)
end
